install_steps: Get the bundle ZIP (the server's own copy if 'archive' is listed, else from the release page) and check its SHA-256 against the value shown here or in the release's SHA256SUMS.
Unzip it, then from inside the unzipped folder run: ./install.sh --target <component repo>   (this prints a plan and writes nothing).
Read the plan, then add --apply. Use --profile build (default), quality or single, and --format claude, copilot or skills.
Review and commit the result in the component repository. Later updates are the same command; files you changed are kept unless you pass --force.
result.next: Install the handoff helpers too with wiki_export_component_helpers_tool(); after agents are in the component repository, publish them to this wiki with wiki_agent_catalog_tool(component).
